class.name: NetwSessionHandle
class.brief_description: The players, scenes and signals of a [member Node.multiplayer] session.
class.description: Reached with [method Netw.session] from any [Node]. Mostly useful for connecting signals. [codeblock] var s := Netw.session(self) s.entered.connect(on_entered) s.disconnected.connect(on_over) s.ended.connect(on_over) for player: NetwPlayer in s.players: scoreboard.add(player) [/codeblock] There is one handle per session, so it is safe to keep it across an await. Connecting is done as you would normally do with [SceneMultiplayer], by assigning [member MultiplayerAPI.multiplayer_peer]. See [NetwConnectHandle] to manage endpoints and [method Netw.prepare_join] to join as a player.

method.name: bucket_of
method.description: The bucket of [param type] that [param peer] carries, [code]null[/code] when it carries none.

method.name: kick
method.description: Removes [param player] from the session and disconnects their peer with [param reason]. The server's own player cannot be kicked, use [method leave] instead. [b]Server Only.[/b]

method.name: leave
method.description: Leaves the session. The server saves its entity rows first, and stays online if the database refuses a row. The promise resolves with an [enum @GlobalScope.Error] once the peer is down or the save failed.

method.name: player_of
method.description: The [NetwPlayer] of [param peer], [code]null[/code] when there is none.

method.name: request_scene
method.description: Asks the server for the scene at [param path] over [param scope]. The promise resolves when the scene is live, or is rejected when the server declines. [b]Player request.[/b]

method.name: save_entities
method.description: Saves every entity row that changed since its last save, including rows of entities that already left. Call it again to retry a row the database refused. [method leave] runs the same save. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK every changed row is stored ┠╴ERR_UNAUTHORIZED this peer is not the server ┠╴ERR_UNCONFIGURED this handle outlived its session ┖╴a row's code the first row still unsaved, see NetwPersistenceHandle.save [/codeblock] [b]Server Only.[/b]

method.name: set_server_info
method.description: Replaces what this session advertises about itself, such as the name shown in a server list. [b]Server Only.[/b]

members.member: A copy of the [NetwSessionConfig] this session was configured with. Writing to it changes nothing, use [method Netw.configure_session] before connecting and [method set_server_info] after.
Whether this peer is a client. A listen server host reads [code]false[/code].
Whether a peer is assigned and connected.
The [NetwPlayer] of this peer, [code]null[/code] until [signal local_joined].

The scene this peer draws, [code]null[/code] when it draws none. It is the scene holding a body of this peer, or else the scene this peer watches. When there are two, it is [code]null[/code] and a warning is logged. On a listen server this is what [HostSceneView] draws. See [method NetwSceneHandle.watch] to choose what a player receives.
Every [NetwPlayer] that has joined, including those whose peer has since disconnected. See [member NetwMultiplayer.connected_players] for only the connected ones.
What this peer is in the session.
The [Node] replicated nodes are under, [code]null[/code] when the session is not in the tree.
Every live scene. Use [method Netw.scene] to reach one by name.
Every counter this session keeps, keyed by [enum NetwMultiplayer.Stat].

signal.name: disconnected
signal.description: Same as [signal MultiplayerAPI.server_disconnected], re-emitted here so it can be connected beside [signal ended].

signal.name: disconnecting
signal.description: The server announced it is going down with [param reason].

signal.name: join_failed
signal.description: This peer's join was rejected with [param code] and the [param reason] the server gave. [member local_player] stays [code]null[/code].

signal.name: local_joined
signal.description: The [NetwPlayer] of this peer has joined. [member local_player] is set from here on.

signal.name: presentation_changed
signal.description: [member presented_scene] changed from [param from] to [param to], either may be [code]null[/code].

signal.name: player_joined
signal.description: A [NetwPlayer] has joined, including this peer's own.

signal.name: player_left
signal.description: A [NetwPlayer] has left, either because their peer disconnected or because of [method kick]. [member NetwPlayer.is_active] is already [code]false[/code].

signal.name: scene_changed
signal.description: A [method Netw.change_scene_to_file] has finished. [param scene] is the destination and [param arrived] are the players it brought, which is where their nodes are spawned. A player already watching the destination is not in [param arrived]. [codeblock] func _on_scene_changed( scene: NetwSceneHandle, arrived: Array[NetwPlayer]) -> void: for who in arrived: scene.root.add_child( Netw.spawn_player(who, make_player)) [/codeblock] [b]Server Only.[/b]

signal.name: scene_live
signal.description: A scene is live. It fires after the scene root is ready, so the whole scene can be accessed. [codeblock] func _on_scene_live(arena: NetwSceneHandle) -> void: arena.root.get_node(^"Spawns").arrange() [/codeblock]
